notes.subject: Yakov
notes.rationale: Esav i tokim Yakov dairet long dispela tok — 'pastaim long yu'.

notes.subject: נסעה ונלכה
notes.rationale: Esav i singautim Yakov: 'yumi kirap na go' — kagem Tok Pisin 'yumi' i makim invitasen.

notes.subject: ונלכה ואלכה
notes.rationale: Hibru i ripitim wokabaut (הלך) tupela taim — 'yumi go, na mi go' — narapela i yumi wantaim, narapela i wanpela man.

translation: Na ⟨em⟩ i tok: Yumi kirap na go, yumi wokabaut, na bai mi go pastaim long yu.
